## Description

Full Arabic RTL for every portal screen (Noto Sans Arabic, flipped chevrons, Arabic dates with readable numerals); help pages (how to sign in, book, see results, consent, caregiver) in English, Hindi and Arabic (plus Tamil for the pilot if needed).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every portal screen passes RTL visual checks at 390 px.
- [ ] **AC2.** Help pages exist in three languages and are linked from the portal.
- [ ] **AC3.** Translations reviewed by a native speaker.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
